summary.allegation: The cardholder says they never received the goods and that the delivery address on the order is not theirs, and that they did not authorise delivery to that address.
summary.to_defend: Visa requires proof the merchandise was delivered, on or before the chargeback date, to an address that materially matches the address the cardholder provided at purchase.

requirements.title: Proof of delivery
requirements.text: Proof of delivery: tracking number, carrier name, and confirmation of delivery to the cardholder's address.
requirements.finding: The DPDx tracking screenshot gives a carrier, a tracking number (15441288821100) and a DELIVERED status on 10 April 2025 for a parcel sent by LumaTech Electronics, but the parcel was left unattended in a 'safe place' with no signature, recipient name confirmation or POD photograph, and the delivery address is not the cardholder's billing address.
requirements.gap: No signature, POD photo or geotag, and the recipient is shown only as a generic "Lumatech Customer"; delivery is to M1 7DR, not the cardholder's billing postcode M14 5RT.

requirements.title: Service rendered
requirements.text: For services: evidence the service was rendered on or before the expected date (booking confirmation, attendance log, access logs).
requirements.finding: This is a physical goods order (headphones and an iPad, MCC 5732 consumer electronics), so the services limb does not apply.

requirements.title: Delivered before chargeback date
requirements.text: Date of delivery / service rendered is on or before the chargeback date.
requirements.finding: The carrier record shows delivery on 10 April 2025, well within the period preceding the 2 May 2025 chargeback date.

requirements.title: Delivery address matches
requirements.text: The delivery address materially matches the address provided by the cardholder at purchase.
requirements.finding: The delivery address on the tracking page (Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf, Manchester M1 7DR) matches the shipping address on order #LT-200931, and the merchant asserts the customer entered it at checkout; however the cardholder denies the address, AVS returned N and the billing postcode on file is M14 5RT, so there is no independent proof the address came from the cardholder.
requirements.gap: Nothing links the cardholder to M1 7DR: AVS did not match, 3DS was only attempted, and there is no account history, prior undisputed delivery or customer communication tying A. Carter to that address.

alerts.text: The cardholder states the shipping address is not theirs; the merchant's only answer is its own checkout note, with no independent evidence (account history, prior deliveries, customer correspondence) connecting the cardholder to Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf, M1 7DR.
Billing postcode M14 5RT does not match shipping postcode M1 7DR, AVS returned N and 3DS was only 'attempted', so the cardholder-address link is unverified at authorisation.
Evidence for R1, R3 was read from an image. Check the highlight.

reasons: Key evidence read from an image
Evidence conflicts with the claim or the transaction data

justification: Delivery is proven to an address the cardholder disowns, with AVS N and no signature, so the file needs evidence tying the cardholder to M1 7DR before representment is viable.
rationale: The cardholder denies receiving the goods and denies that Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf, Manchester M1 7DR is their address. LumaTech has produced DPDx tracking 15441288821100 showing the £642.00 order #LT-200931 was delivered on 10 April 2025, before the 2 May 2025 chargeback, which satisfies the delivery-date requirement. However, the parcel was left in a 'safe place' with no signature, no POD image and a generic 'Lumatech Customer' recipient, and the delivery postcode M1 7DR differs from the cardholder's billing postcode M14 5RT with AVS returning N and 3DS only attempted. The merchant's statement that the customer entered the address at checkout is a self-generated note, not independent proof that the cardholder supplied it. Unless the merchant can link this cardholder to the delivery address, the address-match requirement fails and representment is unlikely to succeed.
merchant_requests: Account/order history for the customer account behind order #LT-200931 showing prior undisputed orders delivered to Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf, M1 7DR, with dates and amounts
Any POD image, geotag or courier signature/recipient name from DPDx for tracking 15441288821100 (delivery 10 April 2025)
Login and device records for the account at checkout on 9 April 2025 19:14 BST (IP 188.29.44.179, device fp_c01e84f2b9) compared with previous sessions on the same account
Copies of order confirmation and dispatch emails sent to a.carter****@gmail.com for order #LT-200931, plus any reply or delivery-query correspondence from the customer
Any customer service contact record showing the cardholder acknowledged the order or the M1 7DR address between 9 April and 2 May 2025
